signUp.description: Creates a session and attempts verification email delivery. Delivery failures and email throttling do not fail signup.

login.description: Checks IP and email quotas before issuing a session. Unverified users may log in.

me.description: Returns current email and verification state.

refresh.description: Consumes the refresh token once; replaces both tokens and invalidates the previous access token. Stable management ID and device name survive rotation.

logout.description: Revokes the current access and refresh tokens.

withdraw.description: Deletes the account and cascades deletion to its sessions.

forgotPassword.description: Unknown accounts and throttled requests return the same success message. Delivery is not guaranteed.

resetPassword.description: Consumes a one-use token valid for 30 minutes, revokes all sessions and cancels pending email changes.

changePassword.description: Requires the current password and a different new password. Revokes all sessions and cancels pending email changes.

verifyEmail.description: Consumes a one-use token valid for 24 hours. Does not create or revoke sessions. Submit the link token in the body; there is no GET confirmation route.

resendVerificationEmail.description: Replaces the previous verification token. Unknown, verified, throttled accounts and delivery failures return the same success message.

requestEmailChange.description: Requires current password and a different unused email. Replaces the pending token; current address is unchanged. Throttling returns 429 without Retry-After.

confirmEmailChange.description: Consumes a one-use token valid for 30 minutes belonging to the authenticated user. Marks new email verified; retains only the confirming session and removes pending verification/reset tokens.

sessions.description: Returns only owned unexpired sessions, ordered by createdAt descending then row ID ascending. Optional legacy fields are omitted.

revokeSession.description: Uses the stable management ID, not JWT sid. Current session may be revoked. Foreign and missing IDs both return 404.

logoutOtherSessions.description: Keeps the calling session; revokes all others.

logoutAll.description: Revokes every session including the calling session.
